The idea that information can be hyperlinked together predated HyperCard by decades. It goes back to [link] , which was written in 1945. The same essay also has the fundamental ideas for a citation index.

This gave rise both to the Science Citation Index and to various hypertext systems. For example the famous 1968 presentation [link] , now known as "The Mother of All Demos", demonstrated a working hypertext system among the other jaw-dropping accomplishments.
